spells.name: Terror
spells.effect: Target 2 enemy units within 18" get -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 enemy units within 18" get -1 to morale test rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psychic Blast
spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 1 hit with AP(2) and Deadly(3).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 1 hit with Deadly(3).

spells.name: Forced Aerial Adaptation
spells.effect: Target 2 friendly units within 12" get Flying once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 4 friendly units within 12" get Flying once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psychic Shriek
spells.effect: Target 2 enemy units within 12" take 4 hits each.
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 2 enemy units within 12" take 2 hits each.

spells.name: Infuse Life
spells.effect: Target 3 friendly units within 12" get Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target 6 friendly units within 12" get Regeneration once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Overwhelm
spells.effect: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 6 hits with AP(2).
spells.effectSkirmish: Target enemy unit within 12" takes 3 hits with AP(2).

specialRules.name: Warding
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, and the unit was shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

specialRules.name: Surprise Attack
specialRules.description: Counts as having Infiltrate. The first time this unit is activated, pick one enemy unit within 6" in line of sight, and roll X dice. For each 2+ it takes one hit with AP(1).

specialRules.name: Stealth Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Stealth.

specialRules.name: Ambush Beacon
specialRules.description: Friendly units using Ambush may ignore distance restrictions from enemies if they are deployed within 6" of this model.

specialRules.name: Sturdy
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
specialRules.description: This model and its unit get Hit & Run Shooter.

specialRules.name: Furious Buff
specialRules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Furious once (next time the effect would apply).

specialRules.name: Spell Conduit
specialRules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

specialRules.name: Infiltrate
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

specialRules.name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
specialRules.description: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

specialRules.name: Quick Shot
specialRules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

specialRules.name: Anti-Cover
specialRules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

specialRules.name: Self-Destruct
specialRules.description: If this model is killed in melee, the attacking unit takes X hits. If this model survives melee, after both sides have finished attacking, it is immediately killed, and the enemy unit takes X hits.

specialRules.name: Warden
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: Guarded
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, they get +1 to Defense rolls when shot/charged from over 9"/6" away.

specialRules.name: Fortified
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: AP

specialRules.name: Stealth
specialRules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

specialRules.name: Defense
specialRules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

specialRules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
specialRules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

specialRules.name: Furious
specialRules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: Caster
specialRules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

specialRules.name: Deadly
specialRules.description: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don’t carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

specialRules.name: Flying
specialRules.description: May move through units and terrain, and ignores the effects of Difficult and Dangerous terrain.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.
